mode: Automatic brief audio for genuine native conversation replies; text is delivered first.

modified: brain/core/room_conversation.py (successful reply receipt and allows_reply only)

read_only_live_inventory.source: local /ws/display with the existing public Origin

behavior.selection: Whole plain first line when at most 12 words and 100 characters; otherwise a short first sentence, or fixed on-screen fallback. This does not read long answers in full.
behavior.actual_greeting_regression: Hey! What can I help you with? is preserved whole.
behavior.fallback: I put the details in the chat.
behavior.authority: Immutable internal successful native-turn receipt, exact lease identity, guest/controller generation; checked before queue and immediately before Bus send.
behavior.deduplication: Native thread/turn ID consumed before any await, including skips, UNKNOWN and cancellation.
behavior.speaker: Unique current-room online say bridge, or an explicitly configured ID; no post-selection substitution.
behavior.effects: Only say; Mac default output and volume are untouched.
behavior.logging: Fixed public sentence plus private correlation/status; no reply phrase or arbitrary bridge error text.
behavior.uncertainty: ACKNOWLEDGED means bridge reported spoken playback; physical audibility still needs human confirmation. Already-started playback cannot be undone by revocation.

cases: Genuine final text precedes audio; failed text send starts no audio.
Code, links, unmarked domains, private markers and long prose use a brief safe fallback.
No speaker, offline or ambiguous speaker sends nothing; later availability never replays a skipped turn.
Revoke, expiry, new controller and host reset while queued deny dispatch.
Connection replacement does not migrate queued speech.
Post-send timeout/disconnect/cancellation is UNKNOWN and never retried or substituted.
Reconnected native conversation returns a new genuine text reply despite unresolved prior audio.
Receipt is immutable, absent from JSON and invalidated by a new controller.
Only say is sent; no volume or output selection calls.

remaining: Human confirmation of ordinary conversational speech through the deployed public phone path.

independent_review.result: No blocking defect found in speech source review.
independent_review.scope: Exact lease/controller/generation and post-queue permission; fixed original speaker; once-only native turn; post-text audio cancellation; no volume/output changes.

deployment.human_request: Fresh phone guest, keyboard dictation in own words, report on-screen words and audible reply
